name: This is Holland
funFact: The pavilion recalls the oil drums that once stood on Shell’s Overhoeks site. Its raised silver drum houses the flight experience above a six-metre-high sawtooth glass foyer, supported by mushroom-shaped columns rising from the underground garage.
description: Opened in2017, This is Holland uses moving seats and a panoramic screen for a simulated flight over Dutch landscapes. Its circular pavilion stands between Eye and A’DAM Toren.
